limitations: Rule sensitivity is not encoding error or the prior translated-origin 1ULP implementation bug.
Neither rule is established as the company rule; supplier source vintage and rule are unknown.
Mapped tree-cover loss is not legal deforestation; no compliance or regulatory verdict.
Area and DE-9IM predicates share GEOS topology/geometry; they are not independent implementations.
Scalar center membership uses exact rational ray casting; GEOS remains shared for validity/bounds.
All counts are selected native cells, not hectares, surveyed area, or fraction-weighted loss area.
Full dictionaries are reduced using the accepted helper; this is not an independent reduction certification.
Floating coordinates are not moved; no tolerance. Exact dyadic/scalar fixtures are reported separately.

center_covers.membership: exact polygon covers native cell center, including exterior/hole boundary

common.geometry: original supplied Polygon/MultiPolygon; retain holes; no buffers or resampling
common.outside: unbounded native lattice; selected outside chip retained as unknown
common.reduction: engine.query.summarize_selected unchanged; observed valid land; tri-state periods
common.units: selected native cells; angular overlap fractions are dimensionless, never hectares

positive_area_overlap.membership: GEOS intersection(polygon,native footprint).area > 0; strict; no tolerance
positive_area_overlap.zero_area_contact: intersects and intersection.area == 0; excluded from selected support
